From 09a65adc7d8bbfce06392cb6d375468e2728ead5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mikulas Patocka <mpatocka@redhat.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 19:56:44 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] dm-thin: fix metadata refcount underflow

There's a bug in dm-thin in the function rebalance_children. If the
internal btree node has one entry, the code tries to copy all btree
entries from the node's child to the node itself and then decrement the
child's reference count.

If the child node is shared (it has reference count > 1), we won't free
it, so there would be two pointers to each of the grandchildren nodes.
But the reference counts of the grandchildren is not increased, thus the
reference count doesn't match the number of pointers that point to the
grandchildren. This results in "device mapper: space map common: unable
to decrement block" errors.

Fix this bug by incrementing reference counts on the grandchildren if the
btree node is shared.

Signed-off-by: Mikulas Patocka <mpatocka@redhat.com>
Fixes: 3241b1d3e0aa ("dm: add persistent data library")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/md/persistent-data/dm-btree-remove.c b/drivers/md/persistent-data/dm-btree-remove.c
index 942cd47eb52d..aeec5b9a1dd5 100644
--- a/drivers/md/persistent-data/dm-btree-remove.c
+++ b/drivers/md/persistent-data/dm-btree-remove.c
@@ -490,12 +490,20 @@ static int rebalance_children(struct shadow_spine *s,
 
 	if (le32_to_cpu(n->header.nr_entries) == 1) {
 		struct dm_block *child;
+		int is_shared;
 		dm_block_t b = value64(n, 0);
 
+		r = dm_tm_block_is_shared(info->tm, b, &is_shared);
+		if (r)
+			return r;
+
 		r = dm_tm_read_lock(info->tm, b, &btree_node_validator, &child);
 		if (r)
 			return r;
 
+		if (is_shared)
+			inc_children(info->tm, dm_block_data(child), vt);
+
 		memcpy(n, dm_block_data(child),
 		       dm_bm_block_size(dm_tm_get_bm(info->tm)));
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch modifies `drivers/md/persistent-data/dm-btree-remove.c` to fix a reference count underflow in the `rebalance_children` function when a btree node is shared.

**Modification in `dm-btree-remove.c`:**

- In `rebalance_children`, before reading and merging a child node (when the parent has a single entry), the code now checks if the child block is shared (`dm_tm_block_is_shared`).  
- If the child is shared, it calls `inc_children` on the child's data to increment the reference counts of the grandchildren before the child’s reference count is later decremented.  
- This ensures that when the parent absorbs the child’s entries, the grandchildren’s reference counts correctly reflect all pointers (from both the parent and any other references to the shared child), preventing a refcount underflow.

**Relationship:**  
The fix directly addresses the root cause: when a shared child is collapsed into its parent, the grandchildren’s pointers are duplicated but their reference counts were not increased, leading to an underflow. By incrementing grandchildren refcounts only when the child is shared, the patch maintains correct reference counting while avoiding unnecessary work for non-shared nodes.
